purpose_context: The repository currently contains an older static template, while the live site uses a minimalist black-and-white wave design with Services, Portfolio, and Resume routes. The mission will establish the live design as maintained source, eliminate narrow-screen overflow, improve touch and motion accessibility, and deliver readable mobile inner pages without regressing tablet or desktop layouts.
purpose_tldr: Recreate the deployed minimalist portfolio in its designated repository and make it fully usable on phones.
